北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，体感稍凉，记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and a bit cool, remember to add layers!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感凉爽，外出注意保暖别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, remember to keep warm when heading out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感舒适，湿度稍高，小心感冒。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels pleasant, high humidity, watch out for colds.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，体感湿热，出门记得带伞，注意防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, feels humid and warm. Bring an umbrella and stay dry.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雨，湿度很高，记得带伞，出行注意安全！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is rainy and very humid. Bring your umbrella and stay safe!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感舒适，早晚温差大，注意加衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and pleasant. Big temp difference, remember to layer up.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感微凉，早晚注意保暖，别感冒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is partly cloudy and slightly cool. Keep warm in the morning/evening, avoid colds.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天体感温和，湿度略高，记得保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and mild, with moderate humidity. Keep your spirits up!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天湿度大，体感舒适，但小心潮湿感冒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with high humidity, feels comfortable, but watch out for dampness.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴空万里，体感凉爽，早晚温差大，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and cool. Layer up for the morning and evening, keep warm.
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感微暖，湿度较高，保持心情舒畅。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and slightly warm with high humidity. Keep a good mood!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感偏冷，一定多穿衣物注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy and cold. Make sure to dress warmly.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感凉爽，阳光虽好，记得加件外套。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and cool. Enjoy the sun, but remember your jacket.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感寒冷，湿度也大，请务必多穿。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels cold with high humidity. Please dress very warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感温暖，湿度高，注意防潮保持清爽。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and warm with high humidity. Stay dry and fresh.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感凉意，出门别忘了加件薄外套。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy and cool. Don't forget a light jacket when you go out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感偏冷，风力较大，出门注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is partly cloudy and cold, with strong winds. Dress warmly and protect from wind.
